BiblicalUsage: Shamhuth commanded twenty-four thousand men in the fifth month, as one of David's twelve captains. The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite, and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a captain's month is as holy as a prophet's year, because David's kingdom ran on men who served in their turn.
